_method: Seeded stratified sample (verify/sample.py, seed 20261123, 2 per category). Each label was set by opening the vendor's own pages in a real browser (Claude's built-in browser pane) and reading the page text, independent of the fetch-and-summarise step used in Loop B. Labels follow spec/rubric.md. Frozen before scoring.

3.note: OAuth 2.0 or x-api-token; free 'Sign up for a Sandbox account'; no MCP on the developer portal.

10.note: Key enabled in Profile by a user in an API-enabled group of a customer tenant; client-credentials token. DealCloud MCP over OAuth 2.0.

16.note: No free plan: '30-day free trial, no credit card'.

18.note: Pricing table: 'API access' = no on Free, 200/400/800 calls/min on Standard/Plus/Pro; 15-day trial on paid plans. A free plan exists but has no API.

22.note: 30-day trial, no card. Twilio's MCP server (Public Beta) 'searches and retrieves public API documentation, and it does not connect to a Twilio account'. The account-acting twilio-labs/mcp is experimental, last commit Jul 2025.

29.note: Customers: Basic api_id/api_token. OAuth only for marketplace Technology Partners (form). 'GET FREE ACCESS' trial; 'Full API access' on plans.

32.note: Meta-hosted Ads MCP at https://mcp.facebook.com/ads can create and edit ads, ad sets, campaigns.

35.note: Mailchimp's MCP 'searches documentation, not your Mailchimp account' (docs-only, does not count). Free plan exists; API key on any account (plan table does not list API, residual uncertainty).

41.note: Dev stores via Partner account / Dev Dashboard. Storefront MCP replaced by Shop MCP and UCP MCP at https://{shop}/api/ucp/mcp (catalog, cart). REST Admin API is legacy.

42.note: Product and order abilities via the MCP Adapter plugin, 'developer preview'.

57.note: Pricing page: 'Free tier pricing available' and 'Start free trial'.

59.note: x-api-key; keys come from an 'API-Key-Request' form (work email) or a booked call; pay-as-you-go, no contract. Not instant self-serve, not a partnership either.

63.note: PATs plus OAuth2 apps for public integrations (rubric: primary = OAuth2). Netlify remote MCP server.

67.note: '30-day trial with $400 in free credits'. Snowflake-managed MCP server.

71.note: Notion MCP can search, create and edit pages, manage databases.

75.note: Personal plan 'Free forever'; PAT free to generate.

82.note: 'request Production access... Allow at least one week'. Vendor remote MCP (wrapped by Composio as plaid_mcp, DCR OAuth).

87.note: 2026 developer pricing: Starter free (max 5 connections), Core A$35/mo (50), Plus A$245 (1000), Advanced A$1445 (10,000). Remote MCP server listed under AI toolkit. Free to build, paid to serve many tenants.

98.note: com.mermaidchart/mermaid-mcp: 'Mermaid diagram validation and rendering', remote at mcp.mermaidchart.com (Mermaid Chart, the company behind Mermaid).

100.note: 'Workspace API & webhooks' on Business plan; Free plan includes 'Basic MCP' for Claude/ChatGPT.
